title: The type menus say what they are, not just what they read
goal: In the Text settings, the font, size and weight menus have no names beside them. With one label picked you can guess from what they say (SF Pro, 24 pt, Regular). With several picked, one of them just says Mixed, and a bare word in a row of three unlabelled menus does not say which setting differs.
notes:
TextInspector in Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift. The menus are labelsHidden() Pickers; SelectionMenu now carries a .help() string but nothing visible. Options: a leading caption per row like the Effects sliders, or writing the mixed entry as the setting name (for example "Mixed sizes").

Done: captions live in SelectionMenu (LayersPanel.swift) and in TextInspector.captioned for the align row. Walk: Scripts/playtest/type-menu-labels-walk.json (it depends on the probe's remembered text size being 24 pt; delete the probe's `textStyles` default first, and collapse Arrange/Position/Color/Effects so the Text section fits on screen).
acceptance: With several text layers picked and their sizes differing, it is readable on screen which setting is mixed without hovering
The Text section still fits the dock at its normal width
One text layer picked reads no worse than it does today

log.note: Before building: walked it as a first-timer. Two labels picked with different sizes gives three bare boxes reading SF Pro / Mixed / Regular, and "Mixed" is the same shape as a weight name, so the eye cannot tell whether the size or the weight differs. The notes offered two fixes: captions, or renaming the entry "Mixed sizes". Captions win because the dock already labels every other control that way (Effects sliders, Measure fields), they fix the single-selection read too, and they cost no width. Doing both would be redundant.

Also found the same defect one row down, outside the task's wording: when the picked layers align differently, BOTH segmented alignment controls show nothing picked and neither says which is which. Captioned them Across and Down for the same reason.

Built: SelectionMenu now draws its label as a small secondary caption above the picker instead of labelsHidden with only a help string, and alignRow wraps each segmented control in the same captioned helper. Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift. The file is shared, not forked per release, so Current gets the captions too; forking a 136KB file over a caption would be worse than the porting rule is trying to prevent.

Verified live in the probe with Scripts/playtest/type-menu-labels-walk.json (Screen Recording granted, so real captures). One label picked: Font / SF Pro, Size / 24 pt, Weight / Regular, Across, Down. Size changed to 48 pt on one, both picked: the box under Size reads Mixed while Font and Weight still read their values, so which setting differs is readable without hovering. Nothing widened; the Size and Weight menus still sit side by side at the dock's normal width. Scripts/test.sh: 2789 tests pass.
Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-04-type-menu-labels.json with two real window captures.

Font, Size, Weight, Across and Down each name themselves in a caption above the control in the Text section, so a menu reading Mixed says which setting differs. Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift.
